sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 15 (check 14, A15:E15) and Internal Quality Checks row 15 (E15:G15 annotations); Deterministic Checks C12 and A24/C24 for context
evidence: The only shipped data file is task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (environment/assets holds nothing else; no CSV/TSV). It is 149 bytes, pure ASCII, parses with json.load, and contains exactly {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."} (seed_data.json:1-4). Its SHA256 30cf9958eca69569e0c78ca3ce4ec239c167dd41342baa361c10355b3d92e4b8 equals the manifest entry inputs.task[environment/assets/seed_data.json]. The template placeholder "CHANGE_ME" has been replaced. Self-consistency: there are zero records, so no ids, foreign keys or orphan rows can exist; the empty snippets array agrees with its own note, with instruction.md:3 ('/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish') and with integration.md:7 ('describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation'). The note's scope words (JavaScript and HTML playground, durable revision history) agree with instruction.md:1, overview.md:3, integration.md:7-9 and app_context.md:6; it adds no requirement absent from the brief. Synthetic/clean: no person, organisation, e-mail, account, credential, token, URL or date appears, so the Internal sheet rule 'If task data itself contain credential flag it' (G15) and the skill profile (quality-checks.md:64) are not triggered. Injection: the single free-text field is a plain scope sentence aimed at the builder and restating the brief; it carries no markup, script, SQL, grader-directed or instruction-overriding text. The golden does not depend on hidden seed content: grep of solution/app/server.js and solve.sh finds no read of /assets or seed_data, and the only start-up INSERT (server.js:167) backfills revisions from existing snippet rows, so the reference library starts empty as the seed states; solve.sh removes /app/app.db before copying and the solution tree ships no database file. app_context.md:21 tells judges not to assume an empty library, so no criterion relies on seeded records. Counter-probes: a broken app that copied the seed would gain nothing (no records to display); a conforming app that ignores the seed loses nothing. This row is a static property of shipped bytes and needs no runtime measurement; the raw-evidence index (scripted golden only) was not relied on. Minor observation, not a defect: the Dockerfile COPY and task.toml artifacts line make /assets available as declared.
